FAQ

Coated-paper converting solutions FAQ

Which coating is better for every converter?

Neither is universally best. Food use, equipment, sealing, barrier, printing, documents and end-of-life requirements determine the appropriate trial.

Can both papers be sampled at 200 m?

Yes. A 200 m sample length can be provided in any requested specification after the construction, width and shipping details are confirmed.

What MOQ and lead time should we plan for?

MOQ generally starts at 5 tonnes for coated base paper. The confirmed quantity depends on the selected grade, customization, packaging and order structure and is stated in the written quotation. Lead time depends on the order quantity and production schedule. It is confirmed in the written quotation rather than published as a fixed number of days.

Can we specify a custom roll width and tolerance?

Yes. Roll width can be customized to the converter's required dimension. The 960 mm and 975 mm widths in the available test reports are the nominal widths of those tested samples, not a limit on custom widths. Typical grammage tolerance is ±2 g/m². The accepted tolerance for the specific grade is recorded in the approved specification and written quotation.

Do the available reports certify finished cups or bags?

No. The reports concern coated-paper samples. Finished-product evidence and converting approval remain separate.
